summary: Count tokens with a per-model divisor
description: DEP-06 and DEP-07. The fallback divisor is chosen by model id. context_pct uses that model's window, so one rule set covers a short window and a long window.
scope: The same text yields different token counts for two models
acceptanceCriteria: Text 12345678 with divisor 4 yields 2 and with divisor 8 yields 1. context_pct(8000, 10000) is 0.8. context_pct(8000, 4096) is greater than 1. DEP-06 DEP-07.
constraints: Do not hardcode one divisor for every model.
Do not hardcode 32768 as every model's window.
Do not call a tokenizer service.
